SELECT lev2_name AS region,
       SUM(terminal_sale_amount) AS terminal_sale_amount_total,
       SUM(reduction_gd_sale_amount) AS reduction_gd_sale_amount_total,
       SUM(terminal_sale_amount) - SUM(reduction_gd_sale_amount) AS diff_amount,
       ABS(SUM(terminal_sale_amount) - SUM(reduction_gd_sale_amount)) AS diff_abs
FROM chatbi.ads_bi_month_shop_item_dan_summary_df
WHERE year='2025' AND month='01'
GROUP BY lev2_name
ORDER BY diff_abs DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT lev2_name AS region, lev3_name AS sub_region,
       SUM(terminal_sale_amount) AS terminal_sale_amount_total,
       SUM(reduction_gd_sale_amount) AS reduction_gd_sale_amount_total,
       SUM(terminal_sale_amount) - SUM(reduction_gd_sale_amount) AS diff_amount,
       ABS(SUM(terminal_sale_amount) - SUM(reduction_gd_sale_amount)) AS diff_abs
FROM chatbi.ads_bi_month_shop_item_dan_summary_df
WHERE year='2025' AND month='01'
GROUP BY lev2_name, lev3_name
ORDER BY diff_abs DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT lev2_name AS region, item_dan_name AS item_dan,
       SUM(first_purchase_num) AS first_purchase_num_total,
       SUM(repurchase_in_60_days_num) AS repurchase_in_60_days_num_total,
       SUM(repurchase_in_60_days_num) / NULLIF(SUM(first_purchase_num),0) AS repurchase_rate_60d
FROM chatbi.ads_member_first_purchase_new_customer_total_df
WHERE year='2025' AND month='01' AND item_dan_name IN ('1段','2段','3段')
GROUP BY lev2_name, item_dan_name
ORDER BY lev2_name, item_dan_name
LIMIT 500

SELECT big_system_channel_name AS big_system_channel,
       SUM(heli30_new_customer_num) AS heli30_new_customer_num_total,
       SUM(heli30_repurchase_in_60_days_num) AS heli30_repurchase_60d_total,
       SUM(heli30_repurchase_in_60_days_num) / NULLIF(SUM(heli30_new_customer_num),0) AS heli30_repurchase_rate_60d
FROM chatbi.ads_member_first_purchase_new_customer_total_df
WHERE year='2025' AND month='01'
GROUP BY big_system_channel_name
ORDER BY heli30_new_customer_num_total DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT big_system_channel_name AS big_system_channel,
       SUM(heli30_new_customer_num) AS heli30_new_customer_num_total,
       SUM(heli30_repurchase_in_60_days_num) AS heli30_repurchase_60d_total,
       SUM(heli30_repurchase_in_60_days_num) / NULLIF(SUM(heli30_new_customer_num),0) AS heli30_repurchase_rate_60d
FROM chatbi.ads_member_first_purchase_new_customer_total_df
WHERE year='2025' AND month='01' AND lev2_name='东一区'
GROUP BY big_system_channel_name
ORDER BY heli30_new_customer_num_total DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT lev2_name AS region,
       SUM(potential_num) AS potential_num_total,
       SUM(potential_to_new_num) AS potential_to_new_num_total,
       SUM(potential_to_new_num) / NULLIF(SUM(potential_num),0) AS potential_to_new_rate
FROM chatbi.ads_precision_nutrition_potential_total_df
WHERE year='2025' AND month='01'
GROUP BY lev2_name
ORDER BY potential_to_new_rate ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT lev3_name AS sub_region,
       SUM(potential_num) AS potential_num_total,
       SUM(potential_to_new_num) AS potential_to_new_num_total,
       SUM(potential_to_new_num) / NULLIF(SUM(potential_num),0) AS potential_to_new_rate
FROM chatbi.ads_precision_nutrition_potential_total_df
WHERE year='2025' AND month='01' AND lev2_name='东一区'
GROUP BY lev3_name
ORDER BY potential_to_new_rate ASC
LIMIT 500

SELECT shop_name, dealer_name, official_city AS city, guide_name,
       SUM(shop_sale_qty) AS shop_sale_qty_total,
       SUM(shop_sale_amount) AS shop_sale_amount_total,
       SUM(gd_amount) AS gd_amount_total
FROM chatbi.ads_bi_hs_sale_info_df
WHERE acc_month='2025-01' AND lev2_name='东一区'
GROUP BY shop_name, dealer_name, official_city, guide_name
ORDER BY shop_sale_amount_total DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT is_guide_shop,
       SUM(shop_sale_amount) AS shop_sale_amount_total,
       SUM(shop_sale_qty) AS shop_sale_qty_total,
       SUM(gd_amount) AS gd_amount_total,
       SUM(shop_sale_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(shop_sale_amount)) OVER (),0) AS shop_sale_amount_ratio
FROM chatbi.ads_bi_hs_sale_info_df
WHERE acc_month='2025-01'
GROUP BY is_guide_shop
ORDER BY shop_sale_amount_total DESC

SELECT lev2_name AS region,
       SUM(potential_num) AS potential_num_total,
       SUM(potential_to_new_num) AS potential_to_new_num_total,
       SUM(potential_to_new_num) / NULLIF(SUM(potential_num),0) AS potential_to_new_rate
FROM chatbi.ads_precision_nutrition_potential_total_df
WHERE year='2025' AND month='01'
GROUP BY lev2_name
ORDER BY potential_to_new_rate ASC
LIMIT 500

SELECT lev2_name AS region,
       SUM(potential_num) AS potential_num_total,
       SUM(potential_to_new_num) AS potential_to_new_num_total,
       SUM(potential_to_new_num) / NULLIF(SUM(potential_num),0) AS potential_to_new_rate
FROM chatbi.ads_precision_nutrition_potential_total_df
WHERE year='2025' AND month='01'
GROUP BY lev2_name
ORDER BY potential_to_new_rate ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT p.lev2_name AS region, p.lev3_name AS sub_region,
       SUM(p.potential_num) AS potential_num_total,
       SUM(p.potential_to_new_num) AS potential_to_new_num_total,
       SUM(p.potential_to_new_num) / NULLIF(SUM(p.potential_num),0) AS potential_to_new_rate
FROM chatbi.ads_precision_nutrition_potential_total_df p
JOIN (
  SELECT lev2_name
  FROM chatbi.ads_precision_nutrition_potential_total_df
  WHERE year='2025' AND month='01'
  GROUP BY lev2_name
  ORDER BY SUM(potential_to_new_num) / NULLIF(SUM(potential_num),0) ASC
  LIMIT 3
) b ON p.lev2_name=b.lev2_name
WHERE p.year='2025' AND p.month='01'
GROUP BY p.lev2_name, p.lev3_name
ORDER BY potential_to_new_rate ASC
LIMIT 500

SELECT p.lev2_name AS region, p.lev3_name AS sub_region, p.big_system_channel_name AS big_system_channel,
       SUM(p.potential_num) AS potential_num_total,
       SUM(p.potential_to_new_num) AS potential_to_new_num_total,
       SUM(p.potential_to_new_num) / NULLIF(SUM(p.potential_num),0) AS potential_to_new_rate
FROM chatbi.ads_precision_nutrition_potential_total_df p
JOIN (
  SELECT lev2_name
  FROM chatbi.ads_precision_nutrition_potential_total_df
  WHERE year='2025' AND month='01'
  GROUP BY lev2_name
  ORDER BY SUM(potential_to_new_num) / NULLIF(SUM(potential_num),0) ASC
  LIMIT 3
) b ON p.lev2_name=b.lev2_name
WHERE p.year='2025' AND p.month='01'
GROUP BY p.lev2_name, p.lev3_name, p.big_system_channel_name
HAVING SUM(p.potential_num) > 50
   AND SUM(p.potential_to_new_num) / NULLIF(SUM(p.potential_num),0) < 0.05
ORDER BY potential_to_new_rate ASC
LIMIT 500
